title: Deeper/broader FreeCAD native and InventorLoader ACIS route review
scope: FreeCAD stock DXF/DWG consumer route and its ACIS limitations
Source-available SAT/SAB reader and add-on route availability
Evidence independence, failure reports, and implementation readiness

sources.name: FreeCAD import/export format limits
sources.evidence: Current documentation states FreeCAD DXF is limited to 2D because DXF 3D data uses proprietary ACIS encoding; DWG inherits the same limitation.

sources.name: FreeCAD DWG import chain
sources.evidence: FreeCAD uses external DWG converters to produce DXF, then invokes its standard DXF importer; the documentation describes the CADExchanger route as the only documented 3D DWG option and identifies it as commercial.

sources.name: FreeCAD issue 18454
sources.evidence: A FreeCAD maintainer response says the stock importer cannot read ACIS blobs in DXF. This is project discussion, not a format specification.

sources.name: InventorLoader repository and license
sources.evidence: Repository identifies GPL-2.0 and publishes a FreeCAD add-on with SAT/SAB and DXF-solid import routes.

sources.name: InventorLoader DXF route
sources.evidence: The route uses ezdxf to read DXF, extracts SAT/SAB from entity objects, and passes the payloads to the add-on's AcisReader.

sources.name: InventorLoader ACIS parser and shape import
sources.evidence: The source contains SAT/SAB parsing, typed ACIS entities, and geometry reconstruction; Law.evaluate invokes Python eval. Mutable master was reviewed; no runtime was executed.

sources.name: InventorLoader SAT/SAB import pipeline
sources.evidence: The pipeline creates FreeCAD Part shapes or converts ACIS data through STEP; these are different consumer/projection strategies.

sources.name: InventorLoader open issue 100
sources.evidence: Reporter documents a DXF import strategy KeyError and an empty document using a FreeCAD 1.1 development build.

sources.name: InventorLoader open issue 102
sources.evidence: Reporter documents a SAB conversion TypeError.

sources.name: InventorLoader open issue 103
sources.evidence: Reporter documents a SAT shell-construction failure because no face was recognized.

assessment.inventorloader_role: Optional distinct ACIS parser candidate; uses FreeCAD/OCCT kernel and ezdxf for DXF parsing, so it is not an independent-kernel vote or complete DXF graph-preservation witness.
assessment.dwg_acds_role: Not applicable to DWG AcDs section decoding, record-key joins, ownership, or chunk association; can only be evaluated downstream of independently extracted payload bytes.
assessment.security: The inspected source includes Python eval in Law.evaluate. File-to-evaluation reachability was not audited or executed; require exact-source review and process isolation before any untrusted-input use. This is a risk flag, not a demonstrated exploit.
assessment.failure_reports: Open issues are version- and artifact-scoped reports; they bar assuming route readiness but do not prove all versions fail.

fastest_sequence: Inventory exact FreeCAD/OCCT/importer/converter/add-on/dependency versions on each requested platform; if the add-on is absent, record NOT_AVAILABLE and continue without installing it.
Separate stock 2D/explicit-geometry baseline from ACIS payload behavior and record converter diagnostics separately from importer diagnostics.

If InventorLoader is already available, pin its source and dependencies, inspect eval reachability, and run locally generated short-lived SAT/SAB controls with independent analytic expectations in an isolated process.
Record native-ACIS and STEP-import results separately, including shape validity, body count, bounds, volume, units/transforms, omissions, and diagnostics.
Keep DWG AcDs handle/key/chunk/owner association as a separate prerequisite; InventorLoader cannot close that edge.
implementation_readiness.fixture_policy: No external drawing added or committed; only already-available repository/user material or scratch files created locally from scratch at the composed gate.
